The '''Null Zone''' was an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] devoid of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. On the galactic map, its coordinates were on P-12. The [[Star Chamber (space station)|Star Chamber]] of the [[Star Cabal]] was located in the Null Zone. The Zone also contained [[Scardia Station]].
